title: Student Information Management System demonstration
credentials: none stored here; per-run passwords live only in <run>/work/secrets.json

lines: Student Information Management System
React frontend connected to the Laboratory I REST API
Registration → Enrollment → Grading → Academic Record
An administrator registers a student and prepares a class.
The student is enrolled and the instructor records grades.
The student then retrieves the same saved results.

chapters.title: Backend and frontend connection
chapters.why: Two separate applications: the Laboratory I API and this React frontend.
assertions: .env.demo points the frontend at the demo API

chapters.title: Login and protected navigation
chapters.why: The API issues the session; protected pages require it.

chapters.title: Student search, filters and pagination
chapters.why: Search, filters and pages are sent to the API as query parameters.

chapters.title: Register, validate and edit a student
chapters.why: The registrar creates the main student and links the student account.

chapters.title: Course, term and class setup
chapters.why: A course, a term and an assigned instructor become a class offering.

chapters.title: Student enrollment
chapters.why: The student is enrolled in the prepared class.
assertions: workspace shows WD-A ACTIVE Not graded

chapters.title: Instructor grade entry and correction
chapters.why: The assigned instructor records the result and corrects the final mark.

chapters.title: Student grades and academic record
chapters.why: The student sees the same saved result.
assertions: My Enrollments, My Grades, Academic Record show WD-A

chapters.title: Role restriction and backend 403
chapters.why: Hiding a page is not enough: the API itself refuses the Student.

chapters.title: Student deactivation with confirmation
chapters.why: Lifecycle: the registrar deactivates the student after results are shown.

chapters.title: Backend outage and recovery
chapters.why: The backend is stopped for real; the client must fail gracefully.

chapters.title: Responsive layout and architecture
chapters.why: The layout adapts, and the architecture is simple to explain.

chapters.title: Existing bonus features
chapters.why: Bonus items that are already implemented.

lines: Registration → Class → Enrollment → Grade → Academic Record
One student, one class, one result, seen by three roles.
Routing and one API service
React Router guards protected pages (RequireAuth).
Every request goes through apiRequest() in src/services/api/client.ts.
Authentication
Login returns a JWT from the Lab I API.
It is kept in sessionStorage (per tab) and sent as a Bearer header.
The backend re-checks the role on every request.
Data refresh after changes
After a save, TanStack Query invalidates related queries,
so lists and workspaces re-read the API.
AI-assisted workflow (from docs/AI_DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md)
The log records Codex for repository separation, planning and implementation.
Review evidence it lists: git moves, database hashes, startup checks,
lint, typecheck, tests, build and live smoke checks.
